overview: Apartments and penthouses sit alongside the Earth, Water and Sky mansion concepts. Services and specifications depend on the residence category.

MAG’s May 2023 release described 177 residences across seven buildings. A later developer milestone described 200; the current portfolio page lists eight buildings. These are different published programmes, not a live availability count.
research.locationNote: Dubai Creek, facing Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. Al Jaddaf is the catalogue location; a sanctuary view does not place the development inside the sanctuary.
research.priceNote: Property Finder retains an AED 6.7 million launch reference; the linked sales-partner microsite advertises AED 6.9 million. Neither confirms a currently available residence.
research.paymentNote: The portal reference below differs from the linked sales-partner site’s 40/60. Obtain a residence-specific schedule; no verified dated payment document was retrieved.
research.handoverNote: The developer’s 2024 milestone targeted Q4 2027. Property Finder retains February/March 2026 dates, which have passed; completion is not independently confirmed.
unresolved: Current availability, residence-specific price and signed payment calendar remain unconfirmed.
